jobs.description:

This position will support SATCOM qualification training through development and review of instructional materials and mission-based simulator support. The engineer will collaborate with headquarters and squadrons to create and enhance courseware, integrate simulator capabilities, and ensure effective delivery of training aligned with SATCOM operational standards. The role combines technical depth with instructional design and classroom augmentation.

Supporting SATCOM qualification training by providing engineering input to classroom instruction and mission-based simulator scenarios.
Developing and reviewing SATCOM-related courseware and training materials required by USSPACECOM headquarters and squadrons.
Applying Instructional Systems Design (ISD) methodologies to develop effective and engaging lesson plans and training objectives.
Providing subject matter expertise in satellite communications across multiple domains.
Supporting SATCOM simulator operations, integration, and troubleshooting to maintain realistic mission training environments.
Coordinating technical requirements and collaborating with stakeholders to ensure training aligns with real-world operational needs.
Enhancing training effectiveness through participation in curriculum reviews, technical assessments, and scenario development.
Other duties as assigned.
Bachelor’s degree and 7+ years of relevant experience.
Hands-on experience in one or more SATCOM domains.
Proficiency with SATCOM planning tools and network monitoring systems.
Strong understanding of RF fundamentals, SATCOM waveforms, and link analysis.
Experience in technical collaboration with government, contractor, and military personnel for training and system integration.
Familiarity with Instructional Systems Design (ISD) and curriculum development methodologies.

Desired Skills:

Prior experience supporting Combatant Command, Major Command, or joint SATCOM training programs.
Experience coordinating with SATCOM stakeholders and participating in mission-focused exercises.
Certifications or coursework in instructional design, SATCOM systems, RF engineering, or related fields.

Must be able to lift up to 25pounds
Must be able to stand and walk for prolonged amounts of time
Must be able to twist, bend and squat periodically

Ready to launch your software career? The Bluestaq Software Engineering Residency Program is an 11.5-week, paid, cohort-based program built around one goal: turning promising early-career developers into full-time Bluestaq Associate Software Engineers.
